query:
SELECT s.id, s.location, s.status, COUNT(c.id) as company_count 
FROM searches s 
LEFT JOIN companies c ON s.id = c.searchId 
WHERE s.location LIKE '%Paris%' 
GROUP BY s.id 
ORDER BY s.createdAt DESC 
LIMIT 5;
